search.offline: No internet. Showing the last results; new searches need a connection.
search.noKey: Add your TMDB key in Settings to search movies.

errors.unauthorized: TMDB rejected the key. Check it in Settings.
errors.rateLimit: Too many requests to TMDB, try again in a few seconds.
errors.server: TMDB is not responding, try again later.

settings.tmdbTokenHint: You need the API Read Access Token: a long string starting with “eyJ”. The short 32-character “API Key” won't work. The key stays on this device only.
settings.attribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
settings.tmdbStep1: Sign in at themoviedb.org and open Settings → API.
settings.tmdbStep2: No key yet? Click “Create”, choose Developer, and fill in the short form (non-commercial use).
settings.tmdbStep3: Copy the “API Read Access Token” and paste it here.
settings.wrongKeyType: That's the short API Key. Use the API Read Access Token from the same page: a long string starting with “eyJ”.
